$comment: Machine-readable twin of spec/errors.md. Both SDKs load this file in tests to assert their class/condition names and the status mapping.

remoteCodes.UNKNOWN_OPERATION: The source has no registered handler for the requested operation.
remoteCodes.BAD_PARAMS: The query envelope did not decode, or params failed the handler's declared validation.
remoteCodes.HANDLER_ERROR: The handler raised. message carries the traceback unless the operation is registered with sanitize.
remoteCodes.GUARD_REFUSED: A source-side guard (maxDistinctPersonIds, minGroupSize) refused the query or the result. No partial result is returned.

terminalCodes.STUDY_COMPLETE: The destination called POST /v1/complete and CLOSE reached this tunnel. Clean end of the source loop.
terminalCodes.SESSION_ERRORED: Dead-letter (MAX_DELIVERIES exceeded), un-ACKed TTL expiry, session closed by the relay, or the tunnel entered ERRORED.
terminalCodes.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: A source-approved cap was breached (rounds, response bytes, query bytes, rounds per hour). Terminal for this leg only.

localClasses.when: Env missing or malformed; endpoint not local; incompatible apiVersion; 401; 403 (wrong role).
Second in-flight request on a peer; 409 from the tunnel.
